shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: Subtle resting state for cards and panels.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Primary easing for animations and transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button. Off-black background, white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-accent); color: #ffffff; padding: 0 16px; height: 40px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action. White background with border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: var(--color-ink); padding: 0 16px; height: 40px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-canvas); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input with border, focus ring, and error state.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-ink); background: var(--color-canvas); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 12px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-ink-muted); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(17,17,17,0.1); } .ds-input.ds-input-error { border-color: var(--color-danger); background: var(--color-danger-light); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard content container. Flat at rest with border.
components.html:
Card Title

Card content goes here.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-surface); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-ink); margin-bottom: 16px; padding-bottom: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border); } .ds-card-body { font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-ink); line-height: 1.65; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar navigation item with active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-ink-secondary); border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--color-canvas); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-nav-item.ds-nav-active { background: var(--color-canvas); color: var(--color-ink); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Status indicator pill. Uppercase, small text.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-badge-success { background: var(--color-success-light); color: var(--color-success); } .ds-badge-warning { background: var(--color-warning-light); color: var(--color-warning); } .ds-badge-danger { background: var(--color-danger-light); color: var(--color-danger); } .ds-badge-info { background: var(--color-info-light); color: var(--color-info); }

narrative.overview: Opsora's design is a structured, data-first system that treats information density and visual clarity as inseparable goals. The aesthetic is precise and professional — every element earns its place through hierarchy, not decoration. The palette is anchored by a single off-black accent (#111111) used sparingly for primary actions, against a near-white canvas and pure white surfaces. Color is functional, never decorative.
keyCharacteristics: Off-black accent carries all primary action states; its rarity is the point
Typography hierarchy through weight and size, never through color alone
Spatial rhythm via consistent spacing scale and generous white space
Functional color: status semantics only, no decorative palettes
Layered depth through subtle shadows that respond to interaction
Refined, restrained feedback on every interactive element

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The off-black accent (#111111) is the only primary action color. Status colors appear in small functional badges and indicators only. Any screen where the accent occupies more than 15% of surface area is over-decorated.

rules.name: The Functional Color Rule
rules.body: Color communicates status, not mood. Each status color maps to one semantic meaning: danger = error/destructive, warning = pending/attention, info = neutral/informational, success = complete/confirmed. Never use status colors for decoration.

rules.name: The Weight Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is built through font-weight and size contrast, never through color alone. Ink (#111111) is the only text color for primary content.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only on interaction (hover, focus) or for genuinely floating elements (modals, dropdowns). Cards at rest use a 1px border, not a shadow.

dos: Do use the off-black accent (#111111) as the single primary action color
Do maintain 7:1 contrast ratio for body text (WCAG AAA) and 4.5:1 for large text
Do build hierarchy through weight (400 → 600 → 700) and size, not through color shifts
Do keep cards flat at rest with a 1px border; add shadows only on hover or for floating elements
Do use the full spacing scale to create rhythmic, intentional layouts
Do include prefers-reduced-motion alternatives for every animation
Do keep touch targets at minimum 44px for the mobile resident portal
donts: Don't use gradients, glassmorphism, or decorative blur effects anywhere
Don't use generic SaaS admin templates with bland card grids
Don't use warm cream/sand/beige as a body background
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text + gradient)
Don't use numbers as section markers (01 / 02 / 03) unless the sequence carries real information
Don't pair two similar fonts (two geometric sans-serifs)
Don't use border-radius greater than 16px on cards
Don't animate CSS layout properties (height, width)
